 Angela Faye Pratt
 Jul 10, 1973 — Nov 3, 2026
 Skipperville
 SKIPPERVILLE…Mrs. Angela Faye Pratt, a resident of Skipperville, passed away Tuesday morning, November 3, 2026, in a Dothan hospital. She was 53. 
 Funeral services will be held at 3:00 P.M. Sunday, November 8, 2026, in the Fuqua Bankston Funeral Home Chapel with Reverend Kenneth Andrews, Reverend Dr. Randy Adams, Reverend Kenneth Hagler, and Mr. Heath Fisher officiating. Burial will follow in Sykes Creek Baptist Church Cemetery, Clio. The family will receive friends from 1:00 until 3:00 P.M. Sunday at the funeral home. Fuqua Bankston Funeral Home of Ozark is in charge of arrangements. 
 Angela was a native of Clio and spent most of her life in the community she loved before making her home in Skipperville in 2021. A proud graduate of Louisville High School's Class of 1991, she later continued her education at Sparks Technical College in Eufaula. Angela was a hardworking and determined woman who pursued her dream of owning and operating Hoppergrass Restaurant in Ozark, where she not only served great food but also built lasting friendships with countless customers who quickly became like family. 
 More than any title or accomplishment, Angela will be remembered for the love she had for her family. Her greatest joy in life was being "Lolli." She cherished every moment spent with her grandchildren, whether sharing laughter, making memories, or simply enjoying their company. They were the light of her life, and she never missed an opportunity to let them know how deeply they were loved. 
 Angela found happiness in life's simple pleasures. She loved sitting by a warm fire on a cool evening, sharing stories and conversation with those she cared about most. Some of her favorite moments were spent at the lake, where she could relax, enjoy nature, and make memories with family and friends. She had a way of making everyone feel welcome and comfortable, and her kind heart, warm smile, and caring spirit left a lasting impression on all who knew her. 
 Though her passing leaves a tremendous void in the hearts of those who loved her, her memory will live on through the countless lives she touched with her kindness, generosity, and unwavering devotion to family. She will be deeply missed and forever remembered. 
 Angela was preceded in death by her father, Durwood Evans; her nephew, Grady Grace; and her uncle, Jason Copeland. 
 Surviving relatives include her husband, Rob Pratt, Skipperville; daughter, Lakyn Andrews (Will), Louisville; son, Evan Pratt (Mackenzie), Clio; mother, Brenda Evans (Jerry Watson), Eufaula; three sisters, Jodie Grace (Calvin), Brandie Trujillo (Cesar), all of Ariton, and Kayla Shaw (Richard), Clio; brother, Trey Evans (Savannah), Clio; three grandchildren, Cohen Andrews, Brantley Pratt, and Stetson Pratt; aunts, uncles, nieces, and nephews. 
 Serving as active pallbearers will be Rob Pratt, Evan Pratt, Trey Evans, Calvin Grace, Cesar Trujillo, and Richard Shaw.
